title: Filing your Company Tax Return online
text:
You should file your Company Tax Return online using commercial software. You can only file a paper return if you:

 • have a reasonable excuse 

 • are filing in Welsh

 Commercial software suppliers also provide services to produce Inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language ( iXBRL ) accounts and computations.

 HMRC accepts returns filed using any of the products shown in this document.

 Filing annual accounts

 Some of the commercial software listed allows you to file your return and annual accounts together.

 You can also find out how to prepare and file annual accounts with Companies House separately.
changeNote: The list of commercial software suppliers for Corporation Tax has been updated with one addition to the 'Produce and Submit CT600' and 'iXBRL integrated Software Application providers' sections.
